scope: Bounded deployed API observation; not public-browser or exact deployed binary proof.

complexity.timeExplanation: N is the number of digits and P is the product of their letter counts. Copying P strings of length N costs O(N * P); the worst case is O(N * 4^N).
complexity.spaceExplanation: O(N) auxiliary space for the shared mutable path and recursive stack, plus O(N * P) returned output storage. Animation snapshots are excluded.

lastStep.description: Every digit's letters tried at every depth. 9 combinations generated.

variables.results: [ad, ae, af, bd, be, bf, cd, ce, cf]

fieldErrors.digits: This input creates too much animation data for one run. Try fewer digits, especially 7 or 9.
